The fake reproduces the full observation size, the 1000-step truncation (config.py:15) and the sparse -1 reward, but not the MuJoCo dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or the peg-in-hole success termination; every start value and step scale in fake.py is marked # placeholder. Five warnings are expected of every Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values, seed twice). Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
